last.verdict: Investors cheered a huge revenue beat and a surprisingly strong growth outlook for next year.

reasons.label: Big growth outlook
reasons.text: Management expects about 70% revenue growth next fiscal year versus roughly 44% analysts expected.

reasons.label: Strong next-quarter forecast
reasons.text: Next-quarter revenue guided to $108B, above the roughly $104B analysts expected, with no China sales assumed.

reasons.label: Beat on sales and profit
reasons.text: Revenue hit $96.2B versus about $92.2B expected; AI data center sales rose 117%.

story: Nvidia has beaten estimates and raised forecasts for several quarters as AI chip demand surged. Yet the stock fell the day after each of its last four reports, by 0.8% to 5.5%. This time a stronger long-term outlook broke that pattern.
